layout.name: moveTime
layout.title: Move Time
layout.tooltip: How long the blade will move for (in ticks).

layout.name: stillTime
layout.title: Still Time
layout.tooltip: How long the blade will stay still for (in ticks).

layout.name: bladeSpeed
layout.title: Speed
layout.tooltip: The speed of the blade. Use negative numbers for going the opposite direction.

layout.name: retractedScale
layout.title: Scale When Retracted
layout.tooltip: The scale of the blade when it is retracted. Keep in mind that setting the scale to 0 does NOT make the blade friendly, unlike piranha plants.
